lenses.label: Raw
lenses.blurb: Unfiltered L−R differential — the signal exactly as the board recorded it.

lenses.label: EOG preflight
lenses.blurb: 0.5–30 Hz band + 50/60 Hz notch. The first EOG-tuned display band.

lenses.label: Offline baseline
lenses.blurb: 0.5–100 Hz. The wide low-pass deliberately passed EMG — the false-positive problem that drove every later narrowing.

lenses.label: Clinical HEOG
lenses.blurb: 0.1–30 Hz literature band. Lower corners keep the saccade step, cut EMG.

lenses.label: Velocity
lenses.blurb: Engbert–Kliegl velocity (Savitzky–Golay derivative). The shift from amplitude to velocity — differentiation self-rejects slow drift.

lenses.label: Matched filter
lenses.blurb: Velocity cross-correlated with a 120 ms Hann saccade template — the statistic the current detector fires on. Integrates over the glance shape for SNR.

lenses.label: z-normalized
lenses.blurb: 0.1–30 Hz divided by the recording's own noise floor, so amplitudes are in σ units comparable across people regardless of signal strength. The dashed line marks 6σ above noise — a significant-excursion reference. (The live detector's actual fire threshold sits on the velocity/matched statistic, not this amplitude band, so this line is a scale guide, not a fire predictor.)
